   FROM teams t
  WHERE ((t.id = team_memberships.team_id) AND (t.created_by = auth.uid())))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM test_ids generated
  WHERE ((generated.definition_id = test_definition_questions.test_definition_id) AND (generated.created_by = auth.uid()))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ((team_assignments assignment
     JOIN team_assignment_recipients recipient ON ((recipient.assignment_id = assignment.id)))
     JOIN team_memberships membership ON ((membership.id = recipient.membership_id)))
  WHERE ((assignment.assignment_type = 'test_id'::text) AND (assignment.test_id = test_ids.id) AND (membership.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (membership.status = 'active'::text))))

declare
  new_batch_id uuid;
  selected_count integer := 0;
  jsonl_payload text;
begin
  perform private.assert_server_context();
  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.deca_batch_jobs
    where status in ('building', 'built', 'validating', 'in_progress', 'finalizing')
  ) then
    return query
    select null::uuid, 0, null::text;
    return;
  end if;

  insert into public.deca_batch_jobs(status, metadata)
  values (
    'building',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'limit_count', limit_count,
      'custom_id_strategy', 'generation_queue_v3.id',
      'target_per_type', 20
    )
  )
  returning id into new_batch_id;

  with selected as (
    select queue.*
    from public.generation_queue_v3 queue
    where queue.status = 'queued'
      and (
        queue.scenario_needed
        + queue.definition_needed
        + queue.fill_needed
        + queue.all_except_needed
      ) > 0
    order by queue.priority asc, queue.created_at asc, queue.id asc
    limit least(greatest(limit_count, 0), 500)
    for update skip locked
  ),
  locked as (
    update public.generation_queue_v3 queue
    set status = 'locked',
        locked_by_batch_id = new_batch_id,
        locked_at = now()
    from selected
    where queue.id = selected.id
    returning queue.*
  ),
  lines as (
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'custom_id', locked.id::text,
      'method', 'POST',
      'url', '/v1/responses',
      'body', jsonb_build_object(
        'model', 'gpt-4.1-mini',
        'metadata', jsonb_build_object(
          'queue_id', locked.id::text,
          'indicator_code', locked.indicator_code
        ),
        'input', concat(
          'Generate DECA practice questions for performance indicator ',
          locked.indicator_code,
          '. Queue ID: ',
          locked.id,
          '. Category: ',
          locked.category,
          '. Partition keys JSON: ',
          locked.partition_keys::text,
          '. Needed counts S/D/F/A: ',
          locked.scenario_needed,
          '/',
          locked.definition_needed,
          '/',
          locked.fill_needed,
          '/',
          locked.all_except_needed,
          '. Return only valid JSON: an array of objects with t, q, o, a, e, d fields. ',
          'Use t values only S, D, F, or A. Use d values only E, M, or H. ',
          coalesce(locked.prompt_context, '')
        )
      )
    )::text as line
    from locked
  )
  select count(*)::integer, string_agg(lines.line, E'\n')
  into selected_count, jsonl_payload
  from lines;

  update public.deca_batch_jobs
  set row_count = coalesce(selected_count, 0),
      status = case when coalesce(selected_count, 0) > 0 then 'built' else 'completed' end,
      completed_at = case when coalesce(selected_count, 0) > 0 then null else now() end,
      metadata = metadata || jsonb_build_object('jsonl_line_count', coalesce(selected_count, 0))
  where id = new_batch_id;

  batch_job_id := new_batch_id;
  row_count := coalesce(selected_count, 0);
  jsonl := jsonl_payload;
  return next;
end;

select coalesce(public.current_team_role(p_team_id) = 'team_admin', false)
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.teams t
      where t.id = p_team_id
        and t.created_by = auth.uid()
    );

select coalesce(public.current_team_role(p_team_id) in ('team_admin', 'co_admin'), false)
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.teams t
      where t.id = p_team_id
        and t.created_by = auth.uid()
    );

select tm.role
  from public.team_memberships tm
  where tm.team_id = p_team_id
    and tm.user_id = auth.uid()
    and tm.status = 'active'
  order by case tm.role
    when 'team_admin' then 1
    when 'co_admin' then 2
    else 3
  end
  limit 1;

select coalesce(
    (
      select case
        when profiles.role = 'owner'
          and (
            profiles.owner_privileges_suspended
            or profiles.owner_state <> 'active'
          ) then 'admin'
        else profiles.role
      end
      from public.profiles
      where profiles.user_id = auth.uid()
        and (
          profiles.suspended_until is null
          or profiles.suspended_until < now()
        )
    ),
    'student'
  );
select replace(replace(replace(p_value, '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_');

select case public.normalize_generated_difficulty(p_value)
    when 'E' then 'Easy'
    when 'M' then 'Medium'
    when 'H' then 'Hard'
    else null
  end;

select case public.normalize_generated_question_type(p_value)
    when 'S' then 'Scenario'
    when 'D' then 'Definition'
    when 'F' then 'Fill In The Blank'
    when 'A' then 'All Except'
    else null
  end;

declare
  actor_id uuid := auth.uid();
  canonical_blueprint jsonb;
  normalized_seed text;
  request_seed_marker text;
  clean_idempotency_key text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_idempotency_key, '')), '');
  request_fingerprint text;
  existing_test public.test_ids%rowtype;
  algorithm_name constant text := 'sha256-strata-v1';
  eligibility_version constant text := 'active-complete-v1';
  generated_code text;
  generated_definition_id uuid := gen_random_uuid();
  code_attempt integer;
  stratum record;
  selected_for_stratum integer;
  shortage_payload jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  resolved_payload jsonb;
  all_difficulties text[];
  all_tags text[];
  eligibility_updated_at timestamptz;
  total_eligible integer;
begin
  if actor_id is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication is required to generate a test.';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.profiles profile
    where profile.user_id = actor_id
      and (profile.suspended_until is null or profile.suspended_until < now())
  ) then
    raise exception 'An active profile is required to generate a test.';
  end if;

  if p_requested_count is null
     or p_requested_count < 1
     or p_requested_count > 250 then
    raise exception 'Requested question count must be an integer between 1 and 250.';
  end if;

  if clean_idempotency_key is not null and length(clean_idempotency_key) > 128 then
    raise exception 'Idempotency key cannot exceed 128 characters.';
  end if;

  canonical_blueprint := public.canonicalize_test_blueprint(
    p_blueprint_id,
    p_expected_blueprint_version
  );

  if p_requested_count <> (canonical_blueprint ->> 'total_questions')::integer then
    raise exception 'Requested count must equal the approved blueprint total for this milestone.';
  end if;

  normalized_seed := public.normalize_test_seed(p_seed);
  request_seed_marker := coalesce(normalized_seed, '<server-generated>');
  request_fingerprint := encode(
    extensions.digest(
      convert_to(
        canonical_blueprint::text || chr(31) || p_requested_count::text || chr(31) ||
        request_seed_marker || chr(31) || algorithm_name || chr(31) || eligibility_version,
        'UTF8'
      ),
      'sha256'
    ),
    'hex'
  );

  if clean_idempotency_key is not null then
    -- Serialize same-user retries before reading the unique idempotency record.
    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(
      hashtextextended(actor_id::text || chr(31) || clean_idempotency_key, 0)
    );

    select *
    into existing_test
    from public.test_ids existing
    where existing.created_by = actor_id
      and existing.idempotency_key = clean_idempotency_key;

    if found then
      if existing_test.request_hash <> request_fingerprint then
        raise exception 'Idempotency key was already used for a different generation request.';
      end if;

      return query
      select
        existing_test.generation_status = 'Ready',
        existing_test.definition_id,
        existing_test.id,
        existing_test.generation_status,
        existing_test.question_count,
        existing_test.selected_question_count,
        existing_test.canonical_seed,
        existing_test.algorithm_version,
        existing_test.blueprint_snapshot,
        existing_test.failure_metadata;
      return;
    end if;
  end if;

  for code_attempt in 1..20 loop
    generated_code := public.generate_test_share_code();
    exit when not exists (select 1 from public.test_ids existing where existing.id = generated_code);
  end loop;

  if generated_code is null
     or exists (select 1 from public.test_ids existing where existing.id = generated_code) then
    raise exception 'Unable to allocate a unique Test ID.';
  end if;

  if normalized_seed is null then
    normalized_seed := generated_code;
  end if;

  drop table if exists pg_temp.milestone6_strata;
  drop table if exists pg_temp.milestone6_selection;

  create temporary table milestone6_strata (
    stratum_id text primary key,
    priority integer not null,
    requested integer not null,
    partition_keys text[] not null,
    performance_indicators text[] not null,
    question_types text[] not null,
    difficulties text[] not null,
    tags text[] not null,
    excluded_tags text[] not null,
    raw_available integer not null default 0
  ) on commit drop;

  create temporary table milestone6_selection (
    question_id uuid primary key,
    stratum_id text not null,
    selection_rank text not null
  ) on commit drop;

  insert into milestone6_strata (
    stratum_id,
    priority,
    requested,
    partition_keys,
    performance_indicators,
    question_types,
    difficulties,
    tags,
    excluded_tags
  )
  select
    item ->> 'id',
    (item ->> 'priority')::integer,
    (item ->> 'count')::integer,
    array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(item -> 'partition_keys')),
    array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(item -> 'performance_indicators')),
    array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(item -> 'question_types')),
    array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(item -> 'difficulties')),
    array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(item -> 'tags')),
    array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(item -> 'excluded_tags'))
  from jsonb_array_elements(canonical_blueprint -> 'strata') item;

  update milestone6_strata target
  set raw_available = inventory.available
  from (
    select
      candidate_stratum.stratum_id,
      count(question.id)::integer as available
    from milestone6_strata candidate_stratum
    left join public.questions question
      on question.lifecycle_state = 'Active'
      and nullif(btrim(question.question_text), '') is not null
      and jsonb_typeof(question.options) = 'array'
      and jsonb_array_length(question.options) = 4
      and question.correct_option_id in ('A', 'B', 'C', 'D')
      and question.difficulty in ('Easy', 'Medium', 'Hard')
      and (
        cardinality(candidate_stratum.partition_keys) = 0
        or question.partition_key = any(candidate_stratum.partition_keys)
      )
      and (
        cardinality(candidate_stratum.performance_indicators) = 0
        or question.performance_indicator = any(candidate_stratum.performance_indicators)
      )
      and (
        cardinality(candidate_stratum.question_types) = 0
        or question.question_type = any(candidate_stratum.question_types)
      )
      and (
        cardinality(candidate_stratum.difficulties) = 0
        or question.difficulty = any(candidate_stratum.difficulties)
      )
      and (
        cardinality(candidate_stratum.tags) = 0
        or question.tags @> candidate_stratum.tags
      )
      and (
        cardinality(candidate_stratum.excluded_tags) = 0
        or not question.tags && candidate_stratum.excluded_tags
      )
    group by candidate_stratum.stratum_id
  ) inventory
  where target.stratum_id = inventory.stratum_id;

  for stratum in
    select *
    from milestone6_strata
    order by raw_available asc, priority asc, stratum_id asc
  loop
    insert into milestone6_selection(question_id, stratum_id, selection_rank)
    select
      question.id,
      stratum.stratum_id,
      encode(
        extensions.digest(
          convert_to(
            algorithm_name || chr(31) || normalized_seed || chr(31) ||
            stratum.stratum_id || chr(31) || question.id::text,
            'UTF8'
          ),
          'sha256'
        ),
        'hex'
      )
    from public.questions question
    where question.lifecycle_state = 'Active'
      and nullif(btrim(question.question_text), '') is not null
      and jsonb_typeof(question.options) = 'array'
      and jsonb_array_length(question.options) = 4
      and question.correct_option_id in ('A', 'B', 'C', 'D')
      and question.difficulty in ('Easy', 'Medium', 'Hard')
      and not exists (
        select 1
        from milestone6_selection selected
        where selected.question_id = question.id
      )
      and (
        cardinality(stratum.partition_keys) = 0
        or question.partition_key = any(stratum.partition_keys)
      )
      and (
        cardinality(stratum.performance_indicators) = 0
        or question.performance_indicator = any(stratum.performance_indicators)
      )
      and (
        cardinality(stratum.question_types) = 0
        or question.question_type = any(stratum.question_types)
      )
      and (
        cardinality(stratum.difficulties) = 0
        or question.difficulty = any(stratum.difficulties)
      )
      and (
        cardinality(stratum.tags) = 0
        or question.tags @> stratum.tags
      )
      and (
        cardinality(stratum.excluded_tags) = 0
        or not question.tags && stratum.excluded_tags
      )
    order by
      encode(
        extensions.digest(
          convert_to(
            algorithm_name || chr(31) || normalized_seed || chr(31) ||
            stratum.stratum_id || chr(31) || question.id::text,
            'UTF8'
          ),
          'sha256'
        ),
        'hex'
      ),
      question.id
    limit stratum.requested;

    get diagnostics selected_for_stratum = row_count;

    if selected_for_stratum <> stratum.requested then
      shortage_payload := shortage_payload || jsonb_build_array(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'stratum_id', stratum.stratum_id,
          'requested', stratum.requested,
          'available', selected_for_stratum,
          'raw_available', stratum.raw_available,
          'constraints_overlap', stratum.raw_available >= stratum.requested,
          'guidance', 'Add eligible active questions or revise the approved blueprint.'
        )
      );
    end if;
  end loop;

  if jsonb_array_length(shortage_payload) > 0 then
    return query
    select
      false,
      null::uuid,
      null::text,
      'Failed'::text,
      p_requested_count,
      (select count(*)::integer from milestone6_selection),
      normalized_seed,
      algorithm_name,
      canonical_blueprint,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'requested_total', p_requested_count,
        'available_selected_total', (select count(*) from milestone6_selection),
        'unsatisfied_strata', shortage_payload
      );
    return;
  end if;

  select coalesce(array_agg(distinct difficulty order by difficulty), '{}'::text[])
  into all_difficulties
  from milestone6_strata,
  unnest(difficulties) difficulty;

  select coalesce(array_agg(distinct tag order by tag), '{}'::text[])
  into all_tags
  from milestone6_strata,
  unnest(tags) tag;

  select
    count(*)::integer,
    max(question.updated_at)
  into total_eligible, eligibility_updated_at
  from public.questions question
  where question.lifecycle_state = 'Active'
    and exists (
      select 1
      from milestone6_strata candidate_stratum
      where question.partition_key = any(candidate_stratum.partition_keys)
        and (
          cardinality(candidate_stratum.performance_indicators) = 0
          or question.performance_indicator = any(candidate_stratum.performance_indicators)
        )
        and (
          cardinality(candidate_stratum.question_types) = 0
          or question.question_type = any(candidate_stratum.question_types)
        )
        and (
          cardinality(candidate_stratum.difficulties) = 0
          or question.difficulty = any(candidate_stratum.difficulties)
        )
        and (cardinality(candidate_stratum.tags) = 0 or question.tags @> candidate_stratum.tags)
        and (
          cardinality(candidate_stratum.excluded_tags) = 0
          or not question.tags && candidate_stratum.excluded_tags
        )
    );

  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'stratum_id', requested.stratum_id,
        'requested', requested.requested,
        'selected', coalesce(selected.selected, 0)
      )
      order by requested.priority, requested.stratum_id
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  into resolved_payload
  from milestone6_strata requested
  left join (
    select stratum_id, count(*)::integer as selected
    from milestone6_selection
    group by stratum_id
  ) selected using (stratum_id);

  insert into public.test_ids (
    id,
    definition_id,
    mode,
    category,
    difficulties,
    topic_tags,
    question_count,
    pool_timestamp,
    created_by,
    blueprint_version_id,
    blueprint_snapshot,
    generation_metadata,
    canonical_seed,
    algorithm_version,
    eligibility_rule_version,
    generation_status,
    selected_question_count,
    resolved_distribution,
    eligibility_snapshot,
    failure_metadata,
    idempotency_key,
    request_hash
  )
  values (
    generated_code,
    generated_definition_id,
    'Test',
    canonical_blueprint ->> 'category',
    all_difficulties,
    all_tags,
    p_requested_count,
    now(),
    actor_id,
    p_blueprint_id,
    canonical_blueprint,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'selection_algorithm', algorithm_name,
      'eligibility_rule_version', eligibility_version,
      'answer_option_shuffling', false,
      'tag_semantics', 'AND',
      'allocation_policy', 'most_constrained_first_v1'
    ),
    normalized_seed,
    algorithm_name,
    eligibility_version,
    'Creating',
    0,
    '{}'::jsonb,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'eligible_question_count', total_eligible,
      'question_bank_updated_at', eligibility_updated_at,
      'captured_at', now()
    ),
    '{}'::jsonb,
    clean_idempotency_key,
    request_fingerprint
  );

  insert into public.test_definition_questions (
    test_definition_id,
    question_id,
    position,
    stratum_id,
    content_hash,
    question_updated_at
  )
  select
    generated_definition_id,
    selected.question_id,
    row_number() over (
      order by
        encode(
          extensions.digest(
            convert_to(
              algorithm_name || chr(31) || normalized_seed || chr(31) ||
              'final-order' || chr(31) || selected.question_id::text,
              'UTF8'
            ),
            'sha256'
          ),
          'hex'
        ),
        selected.question_id
    )::integer,
    selected.stratum_id,
    coalesce(
      question.question_hash,
      encode(
        extensions.digest(
          convert_to(
            jsonb_build_object(
              'question_text', question.question_text,
              'options', question.options,
              'correct_option_id', question.correct_option_id,
              'explanation', question.explanation,
              'difficulty', question.difficulty,
              'tags', question.tags
            )::text,
            'UTF8'
          ),
          'sha256'
        ),
        'hex'
      )
    ),
    question.updated_at
  from milestone6_selection selected
  join public.questions question on question.id = selected.question_id;

  update public.test_ids generated
  set generation_status = 'Ready',
      selected_question_count = p_requested_count,
      resolved_distribution = jsonb_build_object('strata', resolved_payload),
      completed_at = now()
  where generated.definition_id = generated_definition_id;

  return query
  select
    true,
    generated_definition_id,
    generated_code,
    'Ready'::text,
    p_requested_count,
    p_requested_count,
    normalized_seed,
    algorithm_name,
    canonical_blueprint,
    '{}'::jsonb;
end;

begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication is required to launch a Test ID.';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    generated.id,
    generated.definition_id,
    membership.position,
    question.id,
    question.question_type,
    question.question_text,
    question.options,
    question.difficulty,
    question.tags,
    question.performance_indicator,
    question.updated_at > membership.question_updated_at
      or coalesce(
        question.question_hash,
        encode(
          extensions.digest(
            convert_to(
              jsonb_build_object(
                'question_text', question.question_text,
                'options', question.options,
                'correct_option_id', question.correct_option_id,
                'explanation', question.explanation,
                'difficulty', question.difficulty,
                'tags', question.tags
              )::text,
              'UTF8'
            ),
            'sha256'
          ),
          'hex'
        )
      ) <> membership.content_hash
  from public.test_ids generated
  join public.test_definition_questions membership
    on membership.test_definition_id = generated.definition_id
  join public.questions question on question.id = membership.question_id
  where generated.id = upper(btrim(p_test_id))
    and generated.generation_status = 'Ready'
  order by membership.position;
end;

select case
    when count(*) >= 3 then 3
    else greatest(count(*)::integer, 1)
  end
  from public.profiles
  where public.is_eligible_owner(user_id)
    and user_id <> p_target_user_id;

begin
  if not public.is_admin() then raise exception 'Administrator or Owner access is required.'; end if;
  return query
  select report.id, report.status, report.version, report.category,
    report.description, users.email::text, report.created_at, report.updated_at,
    report.resolution_category, report.resolution_message, report.duplicate_of,
    question.id, report.test_id, report.encountered_snapshot,
    question.question_text, question.options, question.correct_option_id,
    question.explanation, question.performance_indicator, question.partition_key,
    question.question_type, question.difficulty, question.tags,
    question.lifecycle_state, question.updated_at,
    report.correction_version_id, report.lifecycle_event_id
  from public.question_reports report
  join public.questions question on question.id = report.question_id
  left join auth.users users on users.id = report.reporter_id
  where report.id = p_report_id;
end;

declare
  actor_id uuid := auth.uid();
  bounded_size integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_page_size, 20), 1), 50);
begin
  if actor_id is null then raise exception 'Authentication is required to view test history.'; end if;
  if (p_cursor_activity_at is null) <> (p_cursor_session_id is null) then
    raise exception 'Both history cursor values are required.';
  end if;
  if p_status is not null and p_status not in ('in_progress', 'paused', 'submitted') then
    raise exception 'Invalid history status.';
  end if;

  return query
  with page as (
    select
      session.id as session_id,
      generated.id as test_id,
      session.mode,
      session.status,
      session.started_at,
      session.last_activity_at,
      session.submitted_at,
      session.question_count,
      coalesce(result.answered_questions,
        (select count(*)::integer from public.test_session_answers answer
         where answer.session_id = session.id)) as answered_questions,
      result.percentage,
      generated.category,
      generated.topic_tags
    from public.test_sessions session
    join public.test_ids generated on generated.definition_id = session.test_definition_id
    left join public.test_results result on result.session_id = session.id
    where session.user_id = actor_id
      and (p_status is null or session.status = p_status)
      and (
        p_cursor_activity_at is null
        or (session.last_activity_at, session.id) < (p_cursor_activity_at, p_cursor_session_id)
      )
    order by session.last_activity_at desc, session.id desc
    limit bounded_size + 1
  )
  select
    page.session_id, page.test_id, page.mode, page.status,
    page.started_at, page.last_activity_at, page.submitted_at,
    page.question_count, page.answered_questions, page.percentage,
    page.category, page.topic_tags,
    (select count(*) > bounded_size from page)
  from page
  order by page.last_activity_at desc, page.session_id desc
  limit bounded_size;
end;

select
    generated.id,
    generated.category,
    generated.difficulties,
    generated.topic_tags,
    generated.question_count,
    generated.created_at,
    generated.blueprint_snapshot ->> 'blueprint_name',
    generated.blueprint_snapshot ->> 'blueprint_version',
    generated.generation_status,
    coalesce((
      select count(*)::integer
      from public.test_definition_questions membership
      join public.questions question on question.id = membership.question_id
      where membership.test_definition_id = generated.definition_id
        and (
          question.updated_at > membership.question_updated_at
          or coalesce(
            question.question_hash,
            encode(
              extensions.digest(
                convert_to(
                  jsonb_build_object(
                    'question_text', question.question_text,
                    'options', question.options,
                    'correct_option_id', question.correct_option_id,
                    'explanation', question.explanation,
                    'difficulty', question.difficulty,
                    'tags', question.tags
                  )::text,
                  'UTF8'
                ),
                'sha256'
              ),
              'hex'
            )
          ) <> membership.content_hash
        )
    ), 0),
    true,
    generated.generation_status = 'Ready'
      and generated.selected_question_count = generated.question_count,
    generated.content_policy,
    resolution.resolution_status,
    resolution.replacement_test_id
  from public.test_ids generated
  left join public.legacy_test_id_resolutions resolution
    on resolution.legacy_test_id = generated.id
  where generated.id = upper(btrim(p_test_id))
    and generated.generation_status in ('Legacy', 'Ready', 'Retired');

declare
  actor_id uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  if actor_id is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication is required to view a test session.';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1 from public.test_sessions session
    where session.id = p_session_id and session.user_id = actor_id
  ) then
    raise exception 'Test session was not found.';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    session.id,
    generated.id,
    session.status,
    session.version,
    session.question_count,
    (select count(*)::integer from public.test_session_answers answer_count
      where answer_count.session_id = session.id),
    session.current_position,
    session.started_at,
    session.last_activity_at,
    session.accumulated_active_seconds + case
      when session.status = 'in_progress' then
        greatest(0, floor(extract(epoch from (now() - session.active_period_started_at)))::integer)
      else 0
    end,
    question.position,
    question.question_id,
    question.question_type,
    question.question_text,
    question.options,
    question.difficulty,
    question.tags,
    answer.selected_option_id,
    answer.answer_version
  from public.test_sessions session
  join public.test_ids generated on generated.definition_id = session.test_definition_id
  join public.test_session_questions question on question.session_id = session.id
  left join public.test_session_answers answer
    on answer.session_id = session.id and answer.question_id = question.question_id
  where session.id = p_session_id
    and session.user_id = actor_id
  order by question.position;
end;
select public.current_user_role() in ('admin', 'owner');

select exists (
    select 1
    from public.profiles
    where user_id = p_user_id
      and role = 'owner'
      and owner_state = 'active'
      and owner_privileges_suspended is not true
      and (
        suspended_until is null
        or suspended_until < now()
      )
  );
select public.current_user_role() = 'owner';

select case lower(trim(coalesce(p_value, '')))
    when 'e' then 'E'
    when 'easy' then 'E'
    when 'm' then 'M'
    when 'medium' then 'M'
    when 'h' then 'H'
    when 'hard' then 'H'
    else null
  end;

select case lower(trim(coalesce(p_value, '')))
    when 's' then 'S'
    when 'scenario' then 'S'
    when 'scenario question' then 'S'
    when 'd' then 'D'
    when 'definition' then 'D'
    when 'definition question' then 'D'
    when 'f' then 'F'
    when 'fill' then 'F'
    when 'fill in the blank' then 'F'
    when 'fill-in-the-blank' then 'F'
    when 'fill in blank' then 'F'
    when 'a' then 'A'
    when 'all except' then 'A'
    when 'all-except' then 'A'
    when 'except' then 'A'
    else null
  end;

declare
  changed_count integer := 0;
begin
  perform private.assert_server_context();
  with active_counts as (
    select
      queue.id as queue_id,
      count(*) filter (
        where public.normalize_generated_question_type(questions.question_type) = 'S'
      )::integer as scenario_count,
      count(*) filter (
        where public.normalize_generated_question_type(questions.question_type) = 'D'
      )::integer as definition_count,
      count(*) filter (
        where public.normalize_generated_question_type(questions.question_type) = 'F'
      )::integer as fill_count,
      count(*) filter (
        where public.normalize_generated_question_type(questions.question_type) = 'A'
      )::integer as all_except_count
    from public.generation_queue_v3 queue
    left join public.questions questions
      on questions.performance_indicator = coalesce(queue.performance_indicator, queue.indicator_code)
      and questions.lifecycle_state = 'Active'
    group by queue.id
  ),
  updated as (
    update public.generation_queue_v3 queue
    set scenario_needed = greatest(0, p_target_per_type - active_counts.scenario_count),
        definition_needed = greatest(0, p_target_per_type - active_counts.definition_count),
        fill_needed = greatest(0, p_target_per_type - active_counts.fill_count),
        all_except_needed = greatest(0, p_target_per_type - active_counts.all_except_count),
        status = case
          when greatest(0, p_target_per_type - active_counts.scenario_count)
             + greatest(0, p_target_per_type - active_counts.definition_count)
             + greatest(0, p_target_per_type - active_counts.fill_count)
             + greatest(0, p_target_per_type - active_counts.all_except_count) = 0 then 'complete'
          when queue.status = 'complete' then 'queued'
          else queue.status
        end
    from active_counts
    where queue.id = active_counts.queue_id
    returning queue.id
  )
  select count(*)::integer into changed_count from updated;

  return changed_count;
end;

declare
  bounded_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_page_size, 25), 1), 100);
begin
  if not public.is_admin() then raise exception 'Administrator or Owner access is required.'; end if;
  if (p_cursor_created_at is null) <> (p_cursor_id is null) then
    raise exception 'Both audit cursor values are required.';
  end if;

  return query
  with page as (
    select audit.*, row_number() over (order by audit.created_at desc, audit.id desc) page_row
    from public.admin_audit_logs audit
    where (p_actor_user_id is null or audit.actor_user_id = p_actor_user_id)
      and (p_action is null or audit.action = p_action)
      and (p_resource_type is null or audit.resource_type = p_resource_type)
      and (p_resource_id is null or audit.resource_id = p_resource_id)
      and (p_report_id is null or audit.report_id = p_report_id)
      and (p_created_from is null or audit.created_at >= p_created_from)
      and (p_created_to is null or audit.created_at <= p_created_to)
      and (p_cursor_created_at is null or (audit.created_at, audit.id) < (p_cursor_created_at, p_cursor_id))
    order by audit.created_at desc, audit.id desc
    limit bounded_limit + 1
  )
  select page.id, page.actor_user_id, page.actor_email, page.actor_role,
    page.action, page.resource_type, page.resource_id, page.report_id,
    page.reason, page.previous_values, page.new_values, page.metadata,
    page.created_at, exists(select 1 from page extra where extra.page_row > bounded_limit)
  from page where page.page_row <= bounded_limit
  order by page.created_at desc, page.id desc;
end;

declare
  requested_limit integer := coalesce(p_page_size, 25);
  bounded_limit integer;
  clean_search text := nullif(trim(coalesce(p_search, '')), '');
begin
  if not public.is_admin() then
    raise exception 'Administrator or Owner access is required for generation pipeline status.';
  end if;

  if requested_limit < 1 then
    raise exception 'Page size must be at least 1.';
  end if;

  bounded_limit := least(requested_limit, 100);

  if (p_cursor_updated_at is null) <> (p_cursor_id is null) then
    raise exception 'Both cursor timestamp and cursor queue id are required.';
  end if;

  return query
  with filtered as (
    select
      queue.*,
      batch.openai_batch_id,
      batch.input_file_id,
      batch.output_file_id,
      batch.row_count,
      batch.status as batch_status,
      batch.created_at as submitted_at,
      batch.imported_count,
      batch.failed_count,
      batch.import_offset,
      batch.error as batch_error
    from public.generation_queue_v3 queue
    left join public.deca_batch_jobs batch on batch.id = queue.locked_by_batch_id
    where (p_status is null or queue.status = p_status)
      and (p_category is null or queue.category = p_category)
      and (p_batch_job_id is null or queue.locked_by_batch_id = p_batch_job_id)
      and (
        clean_search is null
        or queue.id::text = clean_search
        or queue.locked_by_batch_id::text = clean_search
        or queue.indicator_code ilike '%' || public.escape_repository_like(clean_search) || '%' escape '\'
        or coalesce(queue.performance_indicator, '') ilike '%' || public.escape_repository_like(clean_search) || '%' escape '\'
        or coalesce(batch.openai_batch_id, '') ilike '%' || public.escape_repository_like(clean_search) || '%' escape '\'
        or coalesce(queue.last_error, '') ilike '%' || public.escape_repository_like(clean_search) || '%' escape '\'
        or coalesce(batch.error, '') ilike '%' || public.escape_repository_like(clean_search) || '%' escape '\'
      )
      and (
        p_has_errors is null
        or (
          p_has_errors
          and (queue.last_error is not null or batch.error is not null or coalesce(batch.failed_count, 0) > 0)
        )
        or (
          not p_has_errors
          and queue.last_error is null and batch.error is null and coalesce(batch.failed_count, 0) = 0
        )
      )
      and (
        p_cursor_updated_at is null
        or (queue.updated_at, queue.id) < (p_cursor_updated_at, p_cursor_id)
      )
    order by queue.updated_at desc, queue.id desc
    limit bounded_limit + 1
  ),
  numbered as (
    select filtered.*, row_number() over (order by filtered.updated_at desc, filtered.id desc) as page_row
    from filtered
  )
  select
    numbered.id,
    numbered.indicator_code,
    numbered.performance_indicator,
    numbered.category,
    numbered.partition_key,
    numbered.partition_keys,
    numbered.status,
    numbered.scenario_needed,
    numbered.definition_needed,
    numbered.fill_needed,
    numbered.all_except_needed,
    numbered.priority,
    numbered.locked_by_batch_id,
    left(numbered.last_error, 500),
    numbered.created_at,
    numbered.updated_at,
    numbered.batch_status,
    numbered.openai_batch_id,
    numbered.input_file_id,
    numbered.output_file_id,
    coalesce(numbered.row_count, 0),
    coalesce(numbered.imported_count, 0),
    coalesce(numbered.failed_count, 0),
    coalesce(numbered.import_offset, 0),
    left(numbered.batch_error, 500),
    exists (select 1 from numbered extra where extra.page_row > bounded_limit)
  from numbered
  where numbered.page_row <= bounded_limit
  order by numbered.updated_at desc, numbered.id desc;
end;

declare
  bounded_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_page_size, 25), 1), 100);
begin
  if not public.is_admin() then raise exception 'Administrator or Owner access is required.'; end if;
  if (p_cursor_updated_at is null) <> (p_cursor_id is null) then
    raise exception 'Both queue cursor values are required.';
  end if;
  if p_status is not null and p_status not in ('open','in_review','resolved','rejected','duplicate') then
    raise exception 'Invalid report status filter.';
  end if;

  return query
  with page as (
    select report.*, question.performance_indicator, question.question_type,
      question.difficulty, question.lifecycle_state, users.email::text as reporter_email,
      row_number() over (order by report.updated_at desc, report.id desc) page_row
    from public.question_reports report
    join public.questions question on question.id = report.question_id
    left join auth.users users on users.id = report.reporter_id
    where (p_status is null or report.status = p_status)
      and (p_category is null or report.category = p_category)
      and (p_lifecycle_state is null or question.lifecycle_state = p_lifecycle_state)
      and (p_performance_indicator is null or question.performance_indicator = p_performance_indicator)
      and (p_question_type is null or question.question_type = p_question_type)
      and (p_difficulty is null or question.difficulty = p_difficulty)
      and (p_created_from is null or report.created_at >= p_created_from)
      and (p_created_to is null or report.created_at <= p_created_to)
      and (p_cursor_updated_at is null or (report.updated_at, report.id) < (p_cursor_updated_at, p_cursor_id))
    order by report.updated_at desc, report.id desc
    limit bounded_limit + 1
  )
  select page.id, page.question_id, page.test_id, page.category, page.status,
    page.version, page.reporter_email, page.performance_indicator, page.question_type,
    page.difficulty, page.lifecycle_state, page.created_at, page.updated_at,
    exists(select 1 from page extra where extra.page_row > bounded_limit)
  from page where page.page_row <= bounded_limit
  order by page.updated_at desc, page.id desc;
end;

declare
  audit_id uuid;
begin
  if not public.is_admin() then
    raise exception 'Administrator or Owner access required';
  end if;

  insert into public.admin_audit_logs (
    actor_user_id,
    actor_email,
    action,
    resource_type,
    resource_id,
    reason,
    metadata
  )
  values (
    auth.uid(),
    (select email from auth.users where id = auth.uid()),
    action_name,
    resource_type_name,
    resource_id_value,
    reason_value,
    coalesce(metadata_value, '{}'::jsonb)
  )
  returning id into audit_id;

  return audit_id;
end;
